name: brain
description: The Brain — a git-backed, agent-queryable knowledge substrate. Ships the 3-step graph→wiki→raw query rule (as a CLAUDE.md template), the /init /save /resume /freshness /tidy /verify /revise /label /consolidate /promote /wiki-ingest /doctor skills, a self-gating graph-before-grep PreToolUse hook, the vault directory scaffolding + bin scripts, and a multi-vault registry for init-time vault selection (personal vs team). Depends on the graphify CLI (delegated, not vendored). Neutral BRAIN_ROOT contract for consumers.
